messages:
camille: FYI sales forwarded SUP-4821 — customer wants Python SDK + Terraform provider + SSO/SCIM support for marketplace listing. They’re on Dedicated. Can we triage this?

sam: can you paste the thread or a short summary? priority?

camille: summary: FinOps startup needs self-serve infra provisioning (terraform), a simple Python client for our hosted/dedicated API, and SCIM-based provisioning for users/groups. Wants marketplace listing too. Support link: https://redwood.support/tickets/SUP-4821. Sales says target = pilot in ~6 weeks.

jordan: that’s a lot. need to split. terraform provider could be small (resource + docs) but SCIM is nontrivial (audit, tokens). marketplace packaging is separate.

tara: SCIM implies provisioning + audit trails + scoped tokens. Recommend security review before GA. Tag as P2 for now.

vivek: I can take Python SDK ownership. If auth is basic API keys and generate endpoints, 2 sprints. If we need async streaming + session mgmt, add 1 sprint.

camille: proposed split and minimal launch criteria we should capture: 
- Terraform: resource redwood_dedicated (create/read/update/delete), examples, automated smoke test.
- Python SDK: basic auth, sync generate + embeddings, publish alpha to PyPI, example app.
- SCIM: prototype for create user + sync groups, docs, security checklist.
- Marketplace: manifest + sample app as stretch.
All items must have docs + one e2e smoke and owner.

sam: agree. I'll create backlog entries and add tags: integration/terraform, sdk/python, sso/scim, marketplace, customer-request. Each should link back to SUP-4821.

jordan: I’ll spin up infra ticket for provisioning and cadence for canary tests. assign to @jordan.

tara: @vivek please add security tag and a brief estimate on the SDK ticket. We need to validate SCIM token storage (KMS) and audit requirements.

vivek: adding estimates now. Quick Q — does marketplace require any special artifact format or just a repo + manifest? sales asked for listing by EOM.

camille: marketplace needs manifest + screenshots + sample app + pricing tier. Treat listing as stretch but prioritize manifest so sales can start the process.

sam: acceptance criteria I’ll put on each ticket: Terraform CRUD + example, SDK PyPI alpha + examples, SCIM basic flows + security sign-off, docs + quickstart. GA-level polish not required for pilot.

jordan: blockers: billing flow for dedicated provisioning (we need to ensure provisioning ties to customer billing account) and KMS for SCIM tokens.

tara: legal might require customer-managed keys for some customers — flag that if they ask for on-prem or private.

camille: will sync with sales/legal. For now label as P2 and tag according to sam’s list. Assign owners: infra -> @jordan, sdk -> @vivek, scim -> @tara (sec review).

camille: also note acceptance: "example terraform + example python app + SCIM create user end-to-end" as demo for pilot.

ops-bot: Created epic EPIC-1902: "SUP-4821 - Integration: FinOps startup" and linked tickets: T-3281 (terraform), S-4422 (python-sdk), SCIM-101 (scim-prototype).

sam: :thumbsup: I’ll update the intake board and add the tags and support link. anyone object to P2?

jordan: no objections. moving to backlog grooming.

camille: thanks all — I’ll follow up once legal/sales confirm marketplace timeline.
